# The Harbour Ledger

A city news site. Writers draft articles in sections (City, Business, Culture, Sport), editors review drafts, ask for
changes or publish them, and can schedule an article for later. Readers see a front page with the lead story and the
newest articles per section, read articles, bookmark them to read later, follow the sections they care about and
comment at the end of an article. Readers only ever see published articles.

Look: editorial and trustworthy, a classic serif for headlines, off-white paper and a navy accent.
